description: Image Description: The image features a small figurine placed on the keyboard of a Dell laptop. The figurine is an anime-style character with long, vibrant red hair styled in a high ponytail with a curl at the end. She has large, expressive brown eyes and is wearing a white shirt with a green vest and a matching green skirt. Her outfit includes gray boots, and she has a cheerful, slightly mischievous expression on her face. The figurine is standing on a transparent circular base
